description: This script provides a command-line utility for manipulating Android OTA super images, including unpacking, modifying, and repacking images with support for sparse images and custom partition images.

methods.name: existing_abs_path
methods.description: Validates that a path exists and returns its absolute path.

methods.name: partition_image
methods.description: Splits a string of format 'PARTITION=IMAGE_PATH' into its components.

methods.name: unzip_ota_tools
methods.description: Unzips OTA tools archive and sets executable permissions on files in 'bin/' directory.

methods.name: is_sparse_image
methods.description: Checks whether a given image file is a sparse image based on its header.

methods.name: rewrite_misc_info
methods.description: Modifies the misc info file with new image paths and lpmake path, returning partition names.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the unpacking, modification, and repacking of super images.
